Smaller in every case, but the over-count is not removed — 4He's second-order excess is still 1.1868 — so the leading-order over-count is partly cancelled one order up, not eliminated. (This line printed the RATIOS while calling them |ratio − 1|, and quoted a hardcoded grouped-word 1.248, until 2026-09-06; both are now computed.)

description: The Hecke generator in the tensor picture is EXACTLY a transposition plus a diagonal O(eps) operator, so the Markov trace of a braid word expands as a sum over subsets S of letters of fixed-point counts of the sub-word with S deleted, weighted by pattern scalars; order eps^k needs |S| <= k. Implements the expansion to order 2, reproduces c0, c1 and the exact c2 of all six words, and splits c2 by insertion class.

data.verdict: c2 is DERIVED by the same mechanism as c0 and c1, one insertion deeper. The Hecke generator is exactly s + (diagonal, O(eps)), so the trace of any word at any order is a weighted fixed-point count over sub-words; order k needs at most k deletions. Conditional only on the Schur-Weyl identification, which the stage-1 probe checks on these words.
